_comment: Claude in every role, including the prover.
Keys that start with an underscore are comments and are ignored.
A copy of this file with other models or limits is a new configuration (--config FILE).

_roles.orchestrator: Formalizes the problem, plans the proof as lemmas, and takes the lemmas that the prover could not prove.
_roles.checker: Audits each formal statement against the informal one and judges each sketch.
_roles.reviewer: Referees the verified file against the source; a run is proved only if the reviewer finds it faithful.
_roles.writer: Writes the report and the informal proof.
_roles.prover: Proves each lemma. The backend aiprover runs the AIProver harness on the model server of the site.

_agent_fields.backend: claude or codex (the provider's client), openai_compatible (any server with that API), or aiprover (the harness).
_agent_fields.model: The model name; the AIProver server is served as aiprover.
_agent_fields.base_url: Address of an openai_compatible role. http://127.0.0.1:18575/v1 is the model server of the default GPU group (the run job substitutes its own proxy). An address outside the cluster is called through the egress session.
_agent_fields.group: Name of a GPU group in configs/site.json whose server hosts an openai_compatible model.
_agent_fields.api_key_file: Absolute path of a file with the key of an external API.
_agent_fields.tools: Whether the role may use the Lean tools.
_agent_fields.effort: Reasoning effort of a hosted role.
_agent_fields.timeout: Seconds allowed for one call; for the prover, for one job.
_agent_fields.config / max_turns: Prover only: the harness configuration, and the turns of one session.
_agent_fields.phases: Overrides for the phases of a role whose names start with the key, for example judge or escalation.

_options.mode: autoformalize translates the informal proof of the problem; prove searches for a proof.
_options.max_repairs: Rounds of Lean error feedback per chain.
_options.max_replans: Revisions of the proof sketch after failed lemmas.
_options.max_audit_rounds: Revisions of the formalization after a checker finds it unfaithful.
_options.lean_parallel: Concurrent Lean checks of this run.
_options.lean_timeout: Seconds allowed for one Lean check.
_options.max_hosted_calls: Calls to hosted models per run; 0 is unlimited.
_options.max_hosted_usd: Cost of hosted calls per run, in USD at list prices; 0 is unlimited.
_options.aiprover_attempts_per_lemma: Failed attempts allowed per lemma statement.
_options.aiprover_session_slots: AIProver sessions that share one model server; 0 is one job's workers.
_options.aiprover_job_sessions: Sessions of one AIProver job; 0 is no limit.
_options.aiprover_escalation_after: Failed jobs after which a lemma goes back to the orchestrator; 0 is never.
_options.library: A library of verified results to build on; empty for none. See libraries.py.
_options.final_hosted_calls: Hosted calls kept for the final review and the report.
